gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-blinker: Blinker keeps its lines sturdy and its openings generous. Impact Label is built to hit hard, each letter standing apart with pincer-like c ends, while Blinker simply fills the line with lowercase and gets out of the way.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-fresca: Impact Label hits with heavy, commanding letters that stand apart from one another. But Fresca draws a single-weight line, like a plotter pen, and keeps its counters open to the outside.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-gafata: Gafata fills the line with deep lowercase, short stalks rising over it, and a wide-eyed look in every e. Impact Label brings the weight; that gap is the appeal.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-georama: Loud meets friendly: Impact Label slams down heavy, separate letters. And Georama leaves a wide gap in its c, like a bracelet pulled apart, with capitals that barely rise.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hedvig-letter: Impact Label turns each c into open pincers, with every heavy letter standing apart from its neighbors. Hedvig Letters Sans is the friendly foil, its small letters nearly matching capitals.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-heebo: Impact Label arrives heavy and commanding, each letter standing on its own. And it earns its keep big and short, while Heebo lets its curves stop short instead of closing in.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-guntur: Modern in feel, Hind Guntur leaves wide gaps at curve ends. Paragraphs in it would move along smoothly, the stamped-metal lowercase keeping lines uniform, while Impact Label stays the loud one up top.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-madurai: Approachable describes Hind Madurai, whose s curves open wide at both ends and whose lowercase fills the line like capitals. Impact Label hits hardest; Hind Madurai carries the sentences.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary is the feel of Hind Mysuru, lowercase pressed close to ascender height. Text runs smoothly with no thinning strokes and each a left ajar, a quiet backdrop for the blunt weight of Impact Label.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara keeps one thickness in every direction, clean and spacious. Impact Label is best when it shouts and stands apart, while Hind Vadodara does its best work with open e and a shapes.
